technique_name: Summarize a Wikipedia article about the history of bookbinding.
description: Bookbinding is a craft that dates back thousands of years and has evolved over time. The oldest existing bookbinding dates back to around 1,800 BCE and is a clay tablet from Mesopotamia. During the Medieval Period, books were bound using materials such as leather, vellum, and wood. The introduction of the printing press in the 15th century meant that books were now mass-produced and bindings had to be more durable in order to survive the rigours of use.
